How Georgetown connects

  • Location: MacNeil house — The MacNeil house stands in Georgetown.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — The 1973 film is shot and set in Georgetown.
  • Faction: MacNeil family — The MacNeils are living in Georgetown during the film.
  • Faction: Jesuits — Karras's Jesuit world is the Georgetown university parish.
  • Character: Lieutenant Kinderman — Kinderman is the Georgetown detective on Burke's death.

What is Georgetown?

Georgetown is the real neighborhood whose steep stairs, brick houses, and Jesuit university ground the story's possession in a specific city.
